qa_evidence.question: Which congressman is being talked about?

qa_evidence.question: Did he introduce a bill about Nancy Pelosi?
answers: No (Rep. Ralph Abraham, R-La., introduced what's called a resolution in October 2019.)

qa_evidence.question: What is a 'resolution'?
answers: The resolution is what's called a "simple resolution," meaning it has no legal bearing, so to refer to it as a "bill" like this article does is inaccurate. This simple resolution, H. Res. 620, is a one-page document titled "In the Matter of Nancy Pelosi.

qa_evidence.question: Did  it go any further than being introduced?
answers:
No (The resolution never made it any further than being introduced. To be passed, it would need to obtain a two-thirds vote by the House, which had a Democratic majority at the time of the resolution's introduction. Because it is an internal House matter, it would not be voted on by the Senate or signed by the President.

Simple resolutions can be introduced to solely express the sentiments of one or more House members or the entire House, and may not carry with them the expectation of being voted on or passed. In the case of Abraham's resolution, it was introduced in protest of how Pelosi, the first female speaker of the House, was carrying out the Trump impeachment hearings at the time.)

dataset.citation: Schlichtkrull, Guo & Vlachos (2023), AVeriTeC: A Dataset for Real-world Claim Verification with Evidence from the Web, NeurIPS Datasets & Benchmarks.
dataset.format: JSON list of claims with label, questions[].answers[] (annotated QA evidence), claim_types, claim_date. dev_top_k_sentences.json: per claim, the official baseline's top-100 sentences from the official dev knowledge store.
dataset.corpus_note: Per-claim evidence pool = the official baseline's top-100 sentences from the official dev knowledge store (pre-ranked by the organisers with the claim as query, which can favour the ordinary claim query). Each method selects its own evidence from this pool under the same budget.
dataset.relevance_note: No sentence-level gold relevance exists. Retrieval is reported only as a PROXY: whether a retrieved sentence's URL equals an annotated answer source URL.
dataset.time_note: Pool sentences carry no publication date; point-in-time filtering relative to claim_date is not possible here.
dataset.split_note: Official dev split (labelled). The official test split has no public labels.
dataset.sampling_note: Stratified dev sample: 6 annotated causal + 6 other claims (selection uses claim_types annotations; recorded, not used at inference).
